verification_oracle: all mapped acceptance_ids pass on the exact target subject; UNKNOWN and NOT_RUN never count as PASS

results.note: An inferred fact is unstorable without source, evidence, a real-probability confidence and a counterevidence list; each element is enforced individually and the suite removes them one at a time. explainFact surfaces exactly that basis to the user, and the projection keeps references to evidence rather than the evidence text.

Accept, modify, reject, freeze and delete each record a decision and apply it to the fact in one transaction, so the projection never lags the user. A rejected key cannot be re-suggested, a frozen fact cannot be overwritten and is not implicitly unfrozen, and one user's decision leaves another user's profile untouched. The standing decision is chosen by insertion order, so decisions sharing a millisecond resolve deterministically.

Nine sensitive categories can never be inferred at any confidence; consent is matched per category so consenting to one does not unlock another, none of them appears in the ordinary allowlist, and the default projection contains zero sensitive inferences.

The aggregator imports nothing at all, so it cannot reach a model. Output is deterministic under input reordering, an unknown event type is ignored rather than mis-counted, a series contains only the requesting user's counts, and the aggregate is rebuilt from events so a deleted event disappears rather than persisting as a second authority.
